WITH execution_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    COUNT(*) as exec_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
total_executions AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count
  FROM orderexecutions
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ec.ordersmark,
    ec.exec_count,
    CAST(ec.exec_count AS REAL) / te.total_count as share
  FROM execution_counts ec
  CROSS JOIN total_executions te
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM shares
),
with_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    s.ordersmark,
    s.exec_count,
    s.share,
    s.share - a.avg_share as diff
  FROM shares s
  CROSS JOIN avg_share a
)
SELECT 
  ordersmark,
  exec_count,
  share,
  diff
FROM with_diff
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN ordersmark IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
